verdict.rationale: Portal das Finanças is a government tax and customs service portal, not an agent, so publishing an official MCP server is a fair question for it. Nothing in the evidence shows an MCP server or any agent-facing endpoint: the docs cover only web self-service features such as notifications, login, and customs information, and the llms.txt probe returned 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
